name: Bad Breath (Malboro)
doc: Bad Breath (Malboro's enemy attack): the master and the emitter - the breath's mesh from the caster's mouth, its sprites, one target task a target tinting it, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag131_bad_breath.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: The breath's mesh from the caster's mouth, its sprites, one target task a target tinting it, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of a target task

params.label: Target
params.doc: The prim-model layout target (its models' animation)
